summary: The world freezes when villagers with specific trade sets level up
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Create a new Creative world with the attached datapack enabled.
2. Set “Generate Structures” to OFF before creating the world.
3. Spawn a villager in the world.
4. Make the villager a cartographer.
5. Trade with the cartographer until it reaches the next level.
6. Close the trade interface.
7. Wait until the villager levels up.
8. Observe that the world’s server-side processing freezes indefinitely: movement remains possible, but interactions no longer work.
Observed Behavior:
## Actual behavior

When the cartographer reaches the next level, the server attempts to generate the offers for the new trade set. Because every trade in the set fails to produce an offer and duplicate trades are allowed, the offer-generation loop repeatedly selects the same trade entries without exhausting the pool of potential trades.

This results in an infinite loop in `AbstractVillager.addOffersFromItemListings`, causing the server thread to stop processing normally. The client remains connected and can still render the world and accept movement input, but server-side interactions no longer work, including trading and interacting with blocks or entities. The world remains in this state indefinitely until the server is stopped.
Expected Behavior: When the villager levels up, the game should complete the level-up process without freezing, even when its trade set allows duplicate trades and none of the possible trades can generate offers. The world should continue running normally, with the server remaining responsive so players can interact with the villager and other entities.
